source_caption:
The Girl with the Needle (2024) is a haunting black and white portrait set in post war Copenhagen. Directed by Magnus von Horn, the film tells a dark and unsettling story of survival, motherhood, and moral desperation.

With striking visuals and deeply affecting performances, the film feels both raw and poetic. It is disturbing, powerful, and the kind of story that stays with you long after it ends.

source_details.title: The Girl with the Needle
source_details.synopsis: The Girl with the Needle (Danish: Pigen med nålen) is a 2024 Gothic historical psychological horror film directed by Magnus von Horn, from a screenplay written by von Horn and Line Langebek. Set in 1919, the film stars Vic Carmen Sonne as a young woman who begins working as a wet nurse at a secretive adoption agency for disadvantaged mothers, but grows suspicious over the woman who runs the operation. It is very loosely based on the true story of Danish serial killer Dagmar Overbye. The film was selected to compete for the Palme d'Or at the 77th Cannes Film Festival, where it premiered on 15 May 2024 to critical acclaim. It was named one of the top 5 international films of 2024 by the Nation
